facts.fact: The Office of the Accountant General, speaking through a Ministry of Finance principal accountant, called the Government Service Bus, with ZamPortal and ZamPay, central to public service delivery, and said eight councils were already onboarded.

The Accountant General's office says more than 400 government services have been onboarded onto the digital ecosystem of the Government Service Bus, ZamPortal and ZamPay, and plans a rollout to all 116 local authorities.

The Accountant General's office says the digital payment and service platforms have collected more than K8.8 billion (US$488 million); the figure is stated for the platforms together, not for the bus alone.
